mapper.sql: select c.id, c.name, c.provider, c.base_url, c.model, c.api_key_hash, c.dept_id, d.dept_name, c.created_by, u.user_name as created_by_name, c.recipient_id, ru.user_name as recipient_name, c.is_active, c.created_at from team_model_configs c left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.created_by left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = c.recipient_id
mapper.select:
c.is_active = 1 AND ( c.dept_id = #{deptId} OR c.dept_id in ( select child.dept_id from sys_dept child where child.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(#{deptId}, child.ancestors) ) OR (c.dept_id IS NULL AND (c.recipient_id = #{userId} OR (#{userId} IS NULL AND c.recipient_id IS NULL))) )
AND c.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by case when c.dept_id = #{deptId} then 0 when c.dept_id is null then 2 else 1 end, c.created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into team_model_configs ( name, provider, base_url, model, api_key_hash, dept_id, created_by, recipient_id, is_active, created_at ) values ( #{name}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{model}, #{apiKeyHash}, #{deptId}, #{createdBy}, #{recipientId}, #{isActive}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from team_model_configs where id in
#{id}
